notes:
Stage Rotation can now be installed like a normal Windows program.

- Download StageRotationSetup.exe from github.com/fivealarmtech/rotation-releases and run it once: Start menu, desktop shortcut, and Uninstall in Windows Settings > Apps. It moves the app out of its old folder; everything carries over.
- Includes 1.3: the screens open in Stage Rotation's own windows instead of Microsoft Edge.
